messages:
maria: quick async — pulling together owners and due dates for INC-842 RCA items. posting current owners below, please reply with ack, new owner, or updated date. trying to close actions by EOW where feasible. :wave:

- Action A: Investigate memory spikes during longer sequences — current owner: alex — due: 2026-03-24
- Action B: Add KV-cache eviction telemetry + dashboards — current owner: jamal — due: 2026-03-26
- Action C: Canary policy to fallback to smaller model on OOMs — unowned (needs runtime + infra collaboration) — suggested due: 2026-03-25
- Action D: Postmortem doc edits + publish timeline — owner: sophie — due: 2026-03-23

maria: tagging infra/runtime folks — if someone other than alex can own A, pls say so. also flag any blockers (blocks that push beyond suggested date).

alex: ack for A, I can keep it but FYI I'm blocked on repro data from the incident logs — need query from infra. ETA stays 3/24 if I get logs by EOD tomorrow.

jamal: ack B, will add dashboard skeleton today. question: should KV eviction telemetry go to the existing inference-dashboard or a new dashboard? prefer existing to avoid onboarding friction.

maria: +1 to existing dashboard unless it bloats it. jamal, please add a filter for "INC-842" tag in the panel so we can grep quickly.

sophie: ack D, will finish final timeline and push to the doc by 3/23. I also linked the draft: https://docs.redwood/pm/inc842/rca-draft

jamal: for C — I can take the runtime side if infra (alex or someone) is ok to wire the fallback policy into the routing layer. otherwise split ownership.

alex: I can help wire routing but won't be available until 3/24 morning. if we need an earlier cut, we should split: jamal owns runtime change, infra owns routing policy and rollout.

maria: decision: split C into C1 (runtime fallback implementation) -> jamal due 3/25, and C2 (routing policy + rollout) -> alex due 3/26. that gives a small runway for integration tests. please ack individually.

alex: ack for C2 3/26. will add canary playbook snippets to the runbook and schedule a quick validation window.

jamal: ack for C1 3/25. will add unit tests and a local repro harness.

sophie: quick note — add a short blurb in the published RCA about the fallback tradeoffs (latency vs reliability). I'll draft and drop in the doc.

maria: thanks all. follow-ups:
- alex: ping infra to export incident logs query (needed for A) — target 3/18 EOD
- jamal: add dashboard + KV telemetry PR and link here — target 3/20
- sophie: publish final RCA doc and summary to #incidents — target 3/23

maria: if anyone can't meet the dates, reply here and propose alternate owner/date. otherwise I'll close the RCA action list on 3/27 and assign any remaining items to the oncall rotation. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-notice: canary run for model-routing v2 started at 2026-03-18T14:12:03Z — canary id cdn-rca-842-1. no errors so far.

alex: thanks @deploy-bot — will monitor logs and post status here after the validation window.

sophie: ack and thanks everyone for the quick responses.

maria: closing loop for now — keeping this thread open for any late updates.
